title: #270 Parents
prompt: Parents should make important decisions for their older (15 to 18 year-old) teenage children. Do you agree or disagree?

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Parents are best positioned to guide their older children by making decisions regarding crucial areas like education and career paths, ensuring a better life chance.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Parents are best positioned to guide their older children by making decisions regarding crucial areas like education and career paths, ensuring a better life chance.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Parents possess greater life experience than their children, allowing them to guide the child and prevent costly mistakes in areas like the job market or college.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Parents possess greater life experience than their children, allowing them to guide the child and prevent costly mistakes in areas like the job market or college.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Teens need to practice making decisions to learn important life skills.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Teens need to practice making decisions to learn important life skills.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Allowing teens to make choices helps them feel self-worth and control.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Allowing teens to make choices helps them feel self-worth and control.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Parents should guide their older children in making important life choices.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Parents should guide their older children in making important life choices.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Parents should also make decisions for their older children to ensure their safety and well-being.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Parents should also make decisions for their older children to ensure their safety and well-being.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Parents should allow teenagers the space to make their own choices, such as university majors, because forcing decisions can make them feel controlled and hinders the development of self-reliance.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Parents should allow teenagers the space to make their own choices, such as university majors, because forcing decisions can make them feel controlled and hinders the development of self-reliance.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Giving teenagers the chance to make decisions is crucial for learning responsibility, as managing tasks like school schedules teaches them how to handle real-life pressures and setbacks.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Giving teenagers the chance to make decisions is crucial for learning responsibility, as managing tasks like school schedules teaches them how to handle real-life pressures and setbacks.

modelPlan.focus: Explore the role of parents in decision-making for older teenagers, balancing support and fostering independence.
keyArguments: Parents play a crucial role in guiding their teenagers through important decisions, providing support and mentorship.
While parental involvement is essential, it is equally important to allow teenagers to develop autonomy and make their own choices to foster independence.

keyArguments: Parents play a crucial role in guiding their teenagers through important decisions, providing support and mentorship.
